name: Banded Thigh Fly
how_to:
Lying Banded Thigh Fly (Floor Variation)
Starting Position:

- Lie on your back with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.
- Loop a resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees.
- Keep your lower back pressed against the floor and engage your core.
Movement:

1. Slowly open your legs outward against the band’s resistance.
2. Pause when you feel a deep stretch in your inner thighs.
3. With control, bring your legs back together to the starting position.
4. Repeat for 10 to 15 repetitions for three sets.
